src/features/overview/sub_incidents/libs/useIncidentsData.ts:96 The background summary failure uses the sanctioned one-call helper. The list catch is judged under error-doors because it still surfaces a user banner.

pairs.subject: error-handling
pairs.evidence: src/features/overview/components/health/ConfigurationPopup.tsx:96 A failed settings save is caught with logger.warn of the error class plus a toast, and warn stays on the console, so the operator does not get the persisted log door.

techniques.evidence: src/features/overview/components/health/ConfigurationPopup.tsx:96 Save is the user's action. The catch toasts a catalog string and console-warns; it does not call silentCatch or toastCatch. The load catch at line 77 does call silentCatch and sets loadError.

src/features/overview/components/health/ConfigurationPopup.tsx:100 The save toast is a catalog key. The catch comment refuses to put the IPC message, which can echo an API key, into the log or the toast.

src/features/overview/components/health/ConfigurationPopup.tsx:98 The cause message is replaced by err.name or typeof. A Tauri rejection is often a plain object, so the recorded class becomes "object".
src/features/overview/components/dashboard/widgets/MetricHelpPopover.tsx:56 One localStorage blob of dismissed metric tips, not an externally owned collection of independently meaningful items.

src/features/overview/components/dashboard/widgets/MetricHelpPopover.tsx:58 Undeclared catch around JSON.parse. Fallback to an empty set with no helper and no comment; dismissed tips reappear as if nothing was stored.

pairs.subject: error-handling
pairs.evidence: src/features/overview/sub_health/components/heartbeats/HealingEffectivenessPanel.tsx:76 A failed healing-effectiveness load leaves report null, and that null is rendered with the same no-data copy as zero attempts.

techniques.evidence: src/features/overview/sub_events/libs/eventTypeLabel.ts:30 This humanizes an open event-type string for display. It does not decide retry, fault, or remediation categories. Healing rows use tokenLabel for healing_category, which is a label lookup, not the taxonomy authority.
src/features/overview/sub_health/libs/compositeHealthScore.ts:110 DEV-only weight-sum invariant. It throws; it does not relabel a reachable internal failure as a friendlier class.

src/features/overview/sub_health/components/heartbeats/HealingEffectivenessPanel.tsx:76 The load catch is silentCatch only (line 53). After it, loading ends and a null report paints te.no_data, so the user cannot tell failure from an empty window. A breadcrumb is not the user door.
src/features/overview/sub_health/libs/useStatusPageData.ts:96 That message becomes combinedError. MissionStatusMonitor renders it as InlineErrorBanner message={error} with no registry lookup.
src/features/overview/sub_health/libs/useStatusPageData.ts:109 A rejected healing fetch is reduced to message text before it is stored. The category does not cross this hop.
src/features/overview/sub_events/HighlightedJson.tsx:52 One JSON string. A parse miss keeps the original text for display; there is no item collection to isolate.

src/features/overview/sub_health/libs/useStatusPageData.ts:97 The 60s status poll does not call silentCatch or toastCatch. log.warn writes the console only; log.ts forwards the JSONL record for error level alone. setSlaError still feeds the banner, so this is a missed helper, not a blank catch.

src/features/overview/sub_events/libs/useEventLog.ts:214 abort() is called with no reason. The catch returns when signal.aborted and does not count the drop. The same abort covers a newer search and effect cleanup, and the IPC call itself is not cancelled.

src/lib/bindings/HealthBundleErrors.ts:13 The bundle's per-source failure is a bare string. useStatusPageData assigns bundle.errors.healingIssues straight to the user error. Callers cannot branch on a kind.

pairs.registryProposal: Say whether a same-release IPC envelope whose fields are bare reason strings is the sanctioned opaque aggregate or the stringification defect, and whether a Sentry breadcrumb plus a delayed swallow rollup counts as the telemetry door or only a standalone event does.
